# [pixi](../../pixi.md) [auth](../auth.md) token

Print the stored authentication token for a given host

--8<-- "docs/reference/cli/pixi/auth/token_extender:description"

## Usage
```
pixi auth token <HOST>
```

## Arguments
- <a id="arg-<HOST>" href="#arg-<HOST>">`<HOST>`</a>
:  The host to print the stored token for (e.g. prefix.dev)
<br>**required**: `true`
